purpose: Card MUTEX-SHARE-CROSS-EMISSION discharges the residual of the same name, named by card MUTEX-SHARE-CROSS (wave 32) and measured on a CT artifact by card CT-CTWIN-LANE (wave 35). The checked mutex backend now renders a non-nested fork/join trace with real C11 children, so CT46's four unassessed stages -- mutex_reference_execution, c_emission, native_execution and native_sanitized -- move to executed on the case's OWN artifact. Published as a superseding record per constraint 21: the ct-ctwin-lane record keeps its bytes and is not edited.
derivation_rule: A stage is executed only where a named workspace test runs it on the case's own artifact. compiler/tests/ct_corpus.rs::run_mutex_crossing does so on every cargo test of this workspace: it asserts the emitted C's child function, thrd_create and thrd_join, checks that the creator's own body does not carry the child's critical section, compares interpret_mutex_program's observation against the pinned vector, and on Linux and macOS compiles that emitted C under ASan/UBSan/LSan and compares its standard output byte for byte with the same observation. Every arm was falsified by mutation before it was believed. A native run is an observation, never a proof.
what_this_does_not_claim: Contention, a data race, or anything about the C memory model. The checked trace is a total order whose child segment is contiguous between the spawn and the join, so the faithful rendering creates the child thread and immediately joins it: the creator performs no trace event while the child runs. A rendering that let the creator run ahead would realise an order the checker never saw. The discriminating power of these rows is the byte-for-byte observation comparison plus the memory sanitizers (MUTEX-SHARE-CROSS-EMISSION-NO-CONTENTION). TSan is not run anywhere in this repository and no TSan-shaped claim is made here. No Windows or Apple run is claimed: the sanitized rows are gated to linux/macos and only Linux was exercised (MUTEX-SHARE-CROSS-EMISSION-WINDOWS-RUN, MUTEX-SHARE-CROSS-EMISSION-APPLE-RUN).
sanitized_native_growth: 9 of 46 -> 10 of 46. CT46 joins SANITIZED_GATED_CASES. A moved numerator is evidence about one case's artifact, never conformance (constraint 23); the denominator does not move, because no case is mapped or unmapped by this card.
emission_boundary_that_survives: The backend renders a NON-NESTED fork/join trace and nothing wider. A guard-local child (GuardLocalJoin), a nested spawn, a child's events interleaved with its parent's, a custody transfer, a registered waiter and a typed-error exit inside a child are each still outside, published without C. CT46's guard_local.qcore control pins that boundary on a shape reachable from source, so the surviving refusal is not vacuous.
